title: Enphase Energy, Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: Net revenues decreased 20% year over year; U.S. revenue decreased 16%, primarily due to expiration of the federal residential clean energy tax credit under Section 25D.
summary: The SEC-filed Q2 2026 report confirms USD 291.854 million quarterly revenue, a 20% year-over-year decline, 113.8 MWh of battery shipments, USD 937.708 million of cash and marketable securities, USD 572.836 million of debt, USD 143.194 million of six-month operating cash flow, USD 285.022 million of inventory, USD 236.1 million of purchase obligations, and 132.145 million shares outstanding. It also shows that U.S. quarterly revenue declined 16% year over year, safe-harbor shipments were USD 84.3 million, and the reported GAAP gross margin benefited by 15.6 percentage points from tariff refunds.
